title: Code and results for: Box-Counting Analysis of Minnesota Lake Shorelines: Lake Size, Shoreline Length, and Mapping Source
description: This repository holds the code, tests, results files and preprint PDF for a box-counting analysis of Minnesota lake shorelines. The lake data (Minnesota DNR Hydrography Dataset) are not included; the README gives their source. The paper PDF, drafts and figures are licensed CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-paper.md), and the code is licensed MIT.
